Rules & FAQ

The key points of the League Rules in plain words. The full text is legally binding; if anything differs, the full text applies.

Current version League Rules, v1.7

Game 01 runs under this version; the Rules are accepted in the bot. Below are the league rules including the decisions that go into version 1.8 (from Game 02).

The essentials

Contents Taking part Brief and work How to submit Fair play Judging and rounds Rating and leagues Awards and points Certificate Super Final Publishing works FAQ Documents
01

Taking part

  • The League runs online, so you can join from any country. Participants under 18 need parental consent.
  • Register in the Telegram or VK bot: accept the Rules, give your consents and fill in the form.
  • The first Game is free for every new participant. The entry fee for later Games is published before they start.
Section 1 of the Rules
02

Brief and work

  • Each round has a new brief. It says where the work is done, on a model's face or on a practice board, plus other requirements.
Round briefs
03

How to submit

  • Send a photo of your work to the bot.
  • Post the work on your VK or Instagram* page and send the post link to the bot.
  • A work counts as submitted only when both the photo and the link arrive before the deadline. Late works are not accepted.
Publishing competition works · clause 7.8
04

Fair play

  • The work must be your own and follow the round brief.
  • AI-generated images and editing that changes the work itself are not allowed.
  • Keep photos or video of your process: the organizer may ask for the originals.
Originality of works
05

Judging and rounds

  • Judges score works anonymously, without the artists' names. The method depends on the round: head-to-head or by criteria.
  • When works are judged in pairs, the score takes into account whom your work beat: a win over a strong work counts for more.
  • After each round you see your round score (1 to 100), the change in your FPL Rating and whether you advance. Places are not shown during the Game — only in the Game results.
  • The best works of the round in each league get the TOP WORK mark with the league name — e.g. “TOP WORK · Gold”: up to 20% of the league’s works, but no more than 10.
  • If you don't go through to the next round, you can keep painting out of competition.
clause 7.3
06

Rating and leagues

  • The FPL Rating shows an artist's level. It changes after each round and takes the strength of opponents into account.
  • Your rating sets your league (Bronze, Silver or Gold) and whose works yours is compared with.
  • Game 01 has two leagues — League A and League B, set by round 1 (for awards, A = Gold, B = Silver). From Game 02 the league is set by rating before the Game and does not change until it ends; thresholds are announced before the Game starts.
clauses 7.1, 7.2
07

Awards and points

  • Places 1–3 are decided in each league among those who reach the final. The Game result combines the round scores and the final (usually 40% and 60%); the format is announced before the Game starts.
  • Winners and prize-winners in each league receive prizes and medals; the prizes are announced before the Game starts. Everyone who reaches the end of the Game gets a discount on MAGFACE materials.
  • FPL points are your history in the league. For each Game the single highest achievement counts: place 1–3 in your league, your league’s TOP-10 or TOP-25, or completing the Game. Plus one point for each TOP WORK. Points never expire.
  • TOP-10 and TOP-25 are counted within each league, but never more than 20% of its participants: TOP-10 in leagues of 30 or more, TOP-25 in leagues of 100 or more.
clauses 7.5–7.7
08

Certificate

  • You get a certificate if all works of the Game are submitted by its end — including out of competition.
  • Missing a round deadline only costs the credit: such a Game does not count toward the season or the Super Final.
  • Eliminated by the judges but submitted all works by the end of the Game — the certificate is yours.
  • Winners and prize-winners receive a certificate with their place, everyone else a certificate for completing the Game. Each certificate has its own number that can be checked on the website.
clause 7.8 · check a certificate
09

Super Final

  • From a single Game: 1st–3rd place in Gold or 1st place in Silver.
  • Or from the season: 2 of 3 Games in Gold, or all 3 Games in Silver or Gold.
  • The Organizer sets the prize fund. The announced amount won't be reduced, and how it is split is published before the Super Final.
clause 9.1
10

Publishing works

  • The League publishes participants' works on the website and its social media, crediting the artist.
  • The terms are in the Consent to Publication, which you accept at registration.
Consent to distribution

Frequently asked questions

Can beginners join?

Yes. After round one you compete in your own league, with artists at a similar level.

Can I join from another country?

Yes. The League is online, so you can join from any country.

How much does it cost?

The first Game is free for every new participant. The entry fee for later Games is published before they start.

Do I have to play every Game of the season?

No. You can join the season at any Game. But to reach the Super Final through the season standings, you need to play several Games.

Where does the League take place?

Online. Briefs and submissions go through the Telegram or VK bot.

What if I miss the deadline?

A late work does not enter the competition, and the Game does not count toward the season. You can carry on out of competition: if you submit all works by the end of the Game, you still get the certificate.

Paint on a face or on a practice board?

Each round's brief says so: it varies.

Do I need a model?

Not always. It depends on the brief; child models are allowed.

Why post the work on my own page?

It's a submission requirement: a work counts as submitted when the bot has both the photo and a link to the VK or Instagram* post. This way more people see participants' works.

How is the ban on AI and heavy editing enforced?

AI and distorting edits are banned. If needed, we may ask for photos or video of the work in progress.

Who sees my name during judging?

None of the judges: works are scored anonymously. Your name appears only in the published results.

How is the rating different from FPL Points?

The rating goes up and down and shows your current level. FPL Points only add up and show your history of participation and achievements.

How do I get into the Super Final?

Take 1st–3rd place in Gold or 1st place in Silver in any Game. Or through the season standings: 2 of 3 Games in Gold, or all 3 Games in Silver or Gold.

Can I be moved to another league in the middle of a Game?

No. Your league is set before the Game starts and doesn't change until it ends.
